seat_fill_rate.basis: DGT/DITE tracer rates; replace when district MIS actual fill is available

completion_rate.basis: DGT/DITE tracer rates; replace when district MIS actual completion is available

sector_entry_rate.basis: explicit analyst prior pending district placement data

decision_rule: GAP if p90<1; SURPLUS if p10>1; otherwise NEEDS DATA
sci_formula: weighted share of openings covered at R=min(S/D,1)
assumption_note: State manufacturing employment comes from ASI; districts are allocated with Udyam employment shares as a proxy. NCO mix is an analyst prior until PLFS unit-level occupation-by-industry data is loaded. District ITI supply is proxy unless an NCVT MIS district/trade extract is supplied.
